test_gtest_output: test the Google Test output normalization and golden file comparison logic
normalize_gtest_output: normalize Google Test program output by removing locations, stack traces, and timing info
remove_test_output: remove output of specified tests from Google Test output using a regex pattern
generate_gtest_golden: generate a golden reference file for Google Test output comparison
run_gtest_commands: run Google Test commands with various flags like color, time, disabled tests, and sharding
